node: Retail supplier connectivity, EDI, compliance, and order-management networks
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for retail supplier connectivity networks. The strongest direct fit is SPS Commerce, which appears to be the purest US-listed retail EDI / supplier-network asset in this node. Descartes and OpenText are broader B2B / logistics / integration-network platforms with credible second-order exposure, while Manhattan Associates is included as a reference leader in order-management and omnichannel retail workflows rather than a pure EDI network. E2open was screened but excluded because it was acquired by WiseTech Global in 2025 and is no longer an independent US-listed candidate.
